3 صارح بِهِ : see 2. ＝
-A2- [صارحهُ, inf. n. مُصَارَحَةٌ and صِرَاحٌ, He confronted him, or faced him.] One says, شَتَمَهُ مُصَارَحَةً, and صِرَاحًا, (S, K,) and ↓ صُرَاحًا , (K,) which last is a subst. [used as an inf. n., i. e. a quasi-inf. n.], (S, K,) He reviled him confronting him, or face to face, or to his face. (S, K.) And لَقِيتُهُ مُصَارَحَةً, (A, TA,) and صِرَاحًا, and ↓ صُرَاحًا , (TA,) I met him face to face. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
